title: PiCloud overview
description: Raspberry Pi host health, the AI gateway and logs for the PiCloud stack.

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.description: Compose services for the log panels.

list.name: search
list.label: Search logs
list.description: Plain-text filter for the Container logs panel.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Prometheus alerts from deploy/prometheus/rules. No Alertmanager is deployed.

panels.title: CPU temperature
panels.description: SoC temperature. The firmware starts to throttle at 80 °C.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: Busy time across all cores.

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Share of RAM that is not available (MemAvailable).

panels.title: Root filesystem
panels.description: Space used on /, as df and the PiCloud app show it: used / (used + available).

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the host booted.

panels.title: Throttling
panels.description: Firmware throttling flags (under-voltage, frequency cap, throttling, soft temperature limit). No data: the host does not expose get_throttled.

panels.title: CPU temperature and frequency
panels.description: Dashed lines mark 60 °C and 75 °C. A frequency drop while hot means thermal throttling.

panels.title: CPU usage and load
panels.description: CPU usage (left axis) and load average (right axis). Load above the core count means queued work.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Used = total - available. Steady swap use on an SD card slows the Pi and wears the card.

panels.title: Network throughput
panels.description: Physical interfaces only (the agent skips lo, docker*, veth* and br-*). Transmit is drawn below zero.

panels.title: Filesystems
panels.description: Mount points from PI_AGENT_MOUNTS.

panels.title: Throttling state
panels.description: Current firmware flags over time. Under-voltage needs a better power supply; throttling and the soft temperature limit need better cooling.

panels.title: Chat requests
panels.description: Chat requests in the selected time range.

panels.title: Chat error ratio
panels.description: Failed chat requests in the selected time range.

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: Input + output tokens in the selected time range.

panels.title: Fallbacks
panels.description: Times the router skipped a provider and tried the next one.

panels.title: Time to first token (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile time to first token, all providers, selected time range.

panels.title: API latency (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile api response time. Excludes the streaming routes (/api/chat, /api/system/stream).

panels.title: Chat requests by provider and outcome
panels.description: Requests per minute that each provider answered (success) or failed (error).

panels.title: Token throughput
panels.description: Tokens per second by provider: input (prompt) and output (completion).

panels.title: Time to first token
panels.description: Median (solid) and 95th percentile (dashed). A local model on the Pi is slow to start; cloud providers are fast.

panels.title: Provider fallbacks
panels.description: Fallbacks per minute: the provider that the router skipped, and why.

panels.title: Provider circuit breakers
panels.description: A circuit opens after 3 consecutive failures and tries again (half-open) after 30 s.

panels.title: API requests by status
panels.description: All api requests, by HTTP status code.

panels.title: API latency by route (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile response time per route template. Streaming routes are excluded.

panels.title: Log volume by service
panels.description: Container log lines per interval, by compose service.

panels.title: Security events
panels.description: Events per interval from the host: failed SSH logins (journal), fail2ban bans (/var/log/fail2ban.log) and packets that UFW blocked (kernel log).

panels.title: Container logs
panels.description: Logs of the selected compose services. Use the Search box above to filter.

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Container lines that Loki detects as errors, and host journal entries at level error or above.

panels.title: Security log
panels.description: sshd, fail2ban and UFW block messages from the host.
